description: Print button with optional raw-mode toggle

attributes.name: raw-toggle
attributes.description: Adds a checkbox that prints without VB print styles (sets data-print-raw on <html> for the print). The host becomes a labelled role="group"

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Button label / accessible name. Falls back to the authored text content, then "Print this page"

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: icon: printer icon only (label becomes aria-label); label: text only; icon-label: icon and visible text
